answer: Cosignatures are collected in beacon, verified in basalt, and nadir names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 28 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, and thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 95 dollars and 7 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
